༄༅/ /mahā kā la'i gtor chog phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so/ /na maḥshrī ma hā kā lā ya/dpal ldan 'khor lo'i mgon po dang / /bstan srung nag po cha

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/2_SALO/SALO049_ma hā kā la'i gtor chog phrin las lhun grub sogs/.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mahā kā la'i gtor chog phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so// na maḥshrī ma hā kā lā ya/ dpal ldan 'khor lo'i mgon po dang / /bstan srung nag po chen po la/ /btud nas de mnyes mchod pa'i thabs/ /gtor ma'i cho ga bri bar bya/ /dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong rdo rje gur gyi mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ gtor ma 'bags btsog gis ma gos pa lag len ltar bshams la/ dmigs nas bsad pa ma yin pa'i sha khrag gis brgyan te/ nang mchod chu chang gi rim par sbyang ba'i mdun du/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga phreng du bkod/ mgon po'i sku'i rten bris sku bkram/ rang nyid mchod gtor la kha phyogs pa'i mdun du/ nang mchod rdo rje dril bu rnams 'dus byas/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ yi dam gyi lha bde dges lta bu'am/ 'di'i srung 'khor bsgoms pa sngon du btang nas mchod pa la dmigs nas/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor zhing / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs so so'i sngags brjod/ yang gtor ma la dmigs nas/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i nang du a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ go ku/ da/ ha/ na las sha lnga/ de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ aṃ dz+rīṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi dang / ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin zla ba'i mthar/

g.yon skor du a ā/ sogs dbyangs yig bcu drug g.yas skor du/ ka kha ga gha nga / sogs gsal byed so bzhi/ thod pa'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams skol bas rlangs pa gyen la song / oṃ dang rdo rje'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun zags/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i bdud rtsi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon nas/ rdo rje hūm̐ la thim pas/ rdo rje brjid dang ldan par 'gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas/ sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te/ kha dog dang / dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus su/ gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i mtha' skor du brag ri dmar nag gis bskor ba/ drag po'i me rlung 'tshub pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas kyi gri gug g.yon pas thod pa thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/

phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyi klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyi ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na lce spyang / mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi skyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang po'i steng du traka las e ka dza ṭi sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bza'i stod g.yogs dang / stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa'i lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du/ traka las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ /mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / /rlon pa lnga bcus do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ /glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / /ba glang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang pos ska rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / mi ro rings pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang / g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang / zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/

shin tu rid pa/ lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bh+yo'i sgra sgrog pa/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas yaṃ dang / lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ spros pa las/ rtsibs gnyis par yaḥlas nag po gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon zhing gser gyi rna cha can/ rtsibs gsum par maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon klad khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ yab las tri tri/ yum las bh+yo spros pa las/ rtsibs bzhi par triḥlas pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa dar gyi aṅga rag dang / dar nag gi na bza' can/ rtsibs lnga par triḥlas bha ṭa nag po stag slag can/ g.yas dam shing / g.yon mi'i snying 'dzin pa/ rtsibs drug par bh+yoḥlas sring mo ral gcig ma g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon rgyu ma 'dzin zhing / kha nas me 'bar ba/ lnga ka'ang sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / dgra bgegs gyi rgyu ma la rgyus pa'i mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rngam zhing 'khrugs pas dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang g.yas kyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa skyes pa stag chas thogs pa brgya/ g.yon gyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa dge slong gi gzugs can brgya/ mdun gyi shul byang 'dren pa bud med kyi tshul can brgya/ slad kyi rjes su 'brang ba ban+dhe nag po phur thogs brgya/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod par byed pa'i bya nag khyi nag lce spyang / mi nag la sogs pa/ las kyi mgon po la bka' bstod pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/

thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang / rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo dang / las kyi mgon po la bka' stod pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs ba'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /lha mo༞ las mgon༞ zhes pa'i rjes su oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de bī sa pa ri wā ra e h+ya hi/ spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyi gdan dbul/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ma hā kā li de bī sa pa ri wā ra gṛh+ṇe daṃ/ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la/ ma hā kā li de bī sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig bsrungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / bdag gi lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi/ bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyi 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyi 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang / bskrad cing gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang / sdigs shing dpa' skong bar mdzad du gsol/

mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing / bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ ces phrin las bcol/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la kā li de bī sa pa ri wā ra/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa/ i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swāhā/ lnga'am bdun/ shā sa na rtsa sngags gsum brjod/ gong ltar mchod de/ nang mchod phul nas rdo rje dril bu bsil zhing / hūm̐ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba po/ /zhes dang bh+yoḥdapal ldan lha mo re ba ti/ /zhes dang / nag po gnod sbyin yab yum dang / /pu tra bha ṭa ral gcig ma/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs pa'i/ /bstan bsrung 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes las/ /thub pa'i bstan pa dar ba dang / /bstan 'dzin sku tshe rab brtan zhing / /'jig rten bde zhing skyid par mdzod/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag gi/ /mi mthun bar chad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams rab rgyas te/ /bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /ces bstod la phrin las bcol/ /yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs/ mdun gyi lha rnams ras bris yod na de la bstim/ med na bdag la bsdu/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /zhes sogs kyis dge ba bsngo/ 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sprin ltar nag pa'i sku/ /hūm̐ phaṭa nga ro 'brug stong 'dir ba'i gsung / /spros pa nyer zhi mkha' dbyings chen po'i thugs/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la'i bkra shis shog /gang gi mthu yi brgya byin wa ltar zhum/ /ming tsam thos pas nad gdon cog las skyob/ /mtshan mo khams gsum myul ba'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /ma cig srid gsum bdag mo'i bkra shis shog /sprul pa bye bas sa gsum khyab par 'gengs/ bdud dpung tshar gcod sgrub la dngos grub stsol/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa/

pho nya las mkhan rnams kyi bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /'di ni dang po'i blo can 'ga' zhig la phan pa'i phyir dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni zla ba grags pa'o// //mahā kā la'i gtor chog bar chad bdud las rnam rgyal bzhugs/ na maḥshrī ma hā kā lā ya/ bla ma mchog dang lhag pa'i lha/ /dam can rgya mtshor gus btud nas/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bka' srol bzhin/ /gtor ma'i cho ga mdor bsdus bri/ /dpal kye rdo rje dang nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ mchod gtor 'bul bar 'dod pas/ rang gi mdun du mgon po'i sku lugs ma'am/ bris sku bkram pa'i mdun du/ gtor ma'i rgyu gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba la/ yi dam gyi gtor ma zlum po dang / mgon po'i gtor ma zlum po'am/ stod sum gnyis zur gsum/ smad sum cha zlum po la/ mtha' pad 'dab kyi rnam pa'i mtheb kyus bskor ba/ de'i mdun du g.yas nas rim par chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang / rang gi nye bar rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod chang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa bsham ste/ gtor ma nang mchod/ chu chang gi rim par sbyangs la/ rang yi dam/ mgon po gang rung gi nga rgyal la gnas pas/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor ma la 'thor ba'i tshul bya zhing / ngag tu oṃ badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā ma shud+dho3haṃ/ gtor ma'i 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ zla ba'i steng du/ go ku/ da/ ha/ na las sha lnga/ bh+rūm̐/ aṃ/ dz+rīṃ/ khaṃ/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi lnga/ de dag gi steng du ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rigs lnga'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa/

steng gi nam mkhar nyi ma'i dbus su rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos me sbar zhu zhing bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs rdo rje dang bcas pa la thim pas/ 'og tu lhung ste kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bdud bzhi'i gdan la hūm̐ las bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ de'i pang du aṃ las yum rdo rje bdag med ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod par 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i steng du/ gaṃ tsaṃ/ baṃ ghaṃ/ paṃ/ shaṃ/ laṃ/ ḍaṃ rnams las shar du gau ri/ lhor tsau ri/ nub tu baita li/ byang du ghasma ri/ byang shar du puk+ka si/ shar lhor ri khrod ma/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ nub byang du g.yung mo thams cad kyang thod pa dang / rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kye rdo rje lha dgu'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bcom ldan 'das 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ gau ri dang puk+ka si la mi skyod pa/ tsau ri dang sha ba ri la rnam par snang mdzad/

bai ta li dang tsaṇ+ḍa li la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma ri dang / ḍoṃ bhi ni la 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ oṃ badz+ra nai ri te hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ nai bi d+ye hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ sarba saṃ sho dha ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swa hā/ oṃ bha ga wān mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ/ bhuñja/ dzi gha/ phul+la/ dhū paṃ/ maṃ sa/ piṅgha/ aṃ ba/ kadz+dza/ sap+pa/ sā dha khan+ti khu ṇe/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ oṃ a ka ru mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇā ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gtor mgron rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can las 'od zer 'phros pas/ gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / gong gi gtor sngags lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod 'thor zhing / kye rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo thugs kar bzung zhing / g.yon dril bu gsum brdung du bkrol la/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma ri ni sman 'dzin cing / /puk+ka si ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mo'i sku ma 'khyud pa nyid/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa/ khyod kyi rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te/ /snying rje'i thugs kyi sems can sad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges/ /kyai rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang /

/dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la bsrung / /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gtor ma gnyis pa la dmigs nas/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag che zhing cher 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gser gyi gan+ḍe bsnams pa spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyi klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug steng kyi ro yi steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na lce spyang / mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

de'i g.yon du ṭaṃ las e ka dza ṭi sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs pa stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i+i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du/ trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pas rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che' ིko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba glang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang pos ska rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang / g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang / zhag gi zo ris dang / thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bh+yo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ mgon po'i thugs kha nas yaṃ/ lha mo'i thugs kha nas maṃ mdun du spros pa las/ yaṃ las nag po gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas lcags kyi gri gug g.yon spar ba gdengs pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' dang / mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon pa/ maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon spar ba gdengs pa'i mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ byu ru'i lan tshar can/ yab las triḥtriḥyum las bh+yo spros pa las pu tra ming sring gsum du gyur te/

triḥlas las kyi mgon po pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa lcags kyi ral gri dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar gyi aṅga rag dang / dar nag gi na bzas brgyan pa/ triḥlas bha ṭa nag po stag klag can g.yas sher shing gi dam shing dang / g.yon mi'i snying 'dzin pa/ bh+yoḥlas sring mo khrag mig ma kha nas me 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas spu gri/ g.yon mi'i rgyu ma 'dzin zhing za 'og na tri'i gos gyon pa lnga ka'ang sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa/ rus pa'i rgyan dang / mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag rgyu ma la rgyus pa'i do shal can/ gzhan yang g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa skyes pa stag chas can brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren dge slong 'khar sil thogs pa brgya/ rgyab kyi ru 'dren sngags nag ban phur 'dzin pa brgya/ mdun gyi ru 'dren bud med nag mo spar ba gdengs pa brgya/ dam nyams kyi rjes gcod bya nag khyi nag lce spyang / mi nag la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ bh+yoḥ yam̐/ mam̐/ triḥ triḥ bh+yoḥrnams las 'od 'phros/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi pho brang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas mgon po dang sum cu rtsa gsum lha mo'i mkhar sogs nas lha mo/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas las mgon pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan btags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /lha mo kun༞ las mgon kun༞ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de byai/ sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/

gdan dbul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de nas chos skyong gi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya ma hā kā li de byai/ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa/ badz+ra kā li yak+ṣi ṇi/ badz+ra yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru dra bha ṭa/ ru lu rak+ṣa si/ sa pa ri wā ri sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dang / dpal lha mo nag mo 'khor dang bcas pa/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig bsrung cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing rgyas par byed pa dang / bdag cag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad thal ba rdul du brlag pa dang / phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa dang / tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas par mdzod cig ces brjod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ye/ ma hā kā li de bi sa pa ri wā ra na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥ sarba bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa/ i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ lnga'am bdun dang / shā sa na/ rtsa sngags lan gsum brjod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā yai/ ma hā kā li de byai sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs gong ltar mchod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas lha mo la ro ru sogs/ las mgon rnams la oṃ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa la sogs pas nang mchod phul nas/ rdo rje dril bu bsil zhing / hūm̐ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba po/ /ces dang / bh+yoḥdapal ldan lha mo re ba ti/ ces dang / nag po gnod sbyin yab yum dang / pu tra bha ṭa ral gcig ma/ ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs pa'i/ stan bsrung 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes las/

/thub pa'i bstan pa dar ba dang / /bstan 'dzin sku tshe rab brtan zhing / /'jig rten bde zhing skyid par mdzod/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag gi/ /mi mthun bar chad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams rab rgyas te/ /bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /ces bstod la phrin las bcol/ /yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs/ mdun gyi lha rnams ras bris yod na de la bstim/ med na bdag la bsdu/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ ces pas dge ba bsngo/ 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sprin ltar nag pa'i sku/ /ces pas bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /go bde'i ngag gis bkod pa po/ /dpal ldan sa skya lo tsā ba/ /ā nan+da yis nye bar sbyar/ /dge bas mkha' mnyam skye dgu rnams/ /bar chad bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /'chi med dpal 'byor rab rgyas nas/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ ma hā kā la'i gtor chog phrin las lhun grub sogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
